DESIGN STEP
Goal: choose exactly one hyperbolic SID-quality metric that is distinct from the five already measured failures and from Q_H.
Read: the task contract, the 97-pair evidence (Q_H +0.634 at level 1; bucket count -0.065; all partition-own-geometry metrics fail; plain path likelihood anti-correlates because it rewards collapse), and the hint that the surviving direction is a frozen-reference CONTRAST that uses more than one anchor and more than a 10-negative mean.
Observed: the hint names two upgrades: (a) the whole training history as a hyperbolic Frechet barycentre query point, (b) the full negative distribution as a temperatured expected rank, plus a size-matched null to cancel collapse.
Reasoning: combine (a) and (b) at level 1: query = Karcher/Frechet barycentre of the source's training history in the Poincare ball; score = log of the true level-1 cell's total temperatured softmax mass over all N items, divided by the cell's size fraction n_k/N. The size-matched null makes random/hash tables score 0 and a fully collapsed table score 0.
Open: the actual Spearman on the 97 pairs is unknown; this is a proposal, not a measurement. Computability was checked at the stated scale (N=24587, d<=64, K<=256, P=O(N)).

ANSWER RECORD (condensed; the full block is the final response)
METRIC: hyp_history_bary_prefix_enrichment_l1
TITLE: Hyperbolic history-barycentre enrichment of the true level-1 SID prefix over a size-matched null.
FORMULA: Poincare ball B^d_c, curvature -c (c=c_ref), geodesic d_c. For each training source u with history H(u), and each i in H(u) with |H(u)|>=2, let b(u,i)=Karcher/Frechet barycentre of {t_j : j in H(u)\{i\}} via b <- exp_b(mean log_b(t_j)). Define q_j(u,i)=softmax_j(-d_c(b(u,i),t_j)/tau), tau=tau_ref; Q_{k+}=sum of q over the cell c1(i); n_k=cell size. lift(u,i)=log(Q_{k+}*N/n_{k+}). METRIC=source-balanced mean of lift over U={u:|H(u)|>=2}. Higher better.
INPUTS: level-1 integer codes c1(j) from the exported SID table; frozen Issue #126 reference target reps t_j, curvature c_ref, temperature tau_ref; TRAINING split pairs (u,j). Nothing else; no validation/test interaction, no recall, no Stage-3 output.
GEOMETRY: Karcher barycentre with exp/log maps plus geodesic distances in the Poincare ball; curvature enters in the barycentre (hyperbolic, not Euclidean mean) and in every softmax distance.
WHY IT TRACKS RECALL: level-1 prefix is Stage-3's coarse address; the metric is the log-density lift of the true target's cell in the temperatured geodesic neighbourhood of the whole-history barycentre, over the full item population. Adds over Q_H: whole-history Frechet barycentre instead of one anchor; full item-level negative distribution instead of a 10-negative mean; size-matched null n_{k+}/N cancels the collapse reward that broke path likelihood; no hard radius, so not a bucket-reach count.
COMPUTE: geometry is table-independent and computed once (Karcher O(|H|d) per iter, softmax row O(Nd) per example); per table only cell sums change, O(N) scatter-add plus O(|cell|) per example; N=24587, d<=64, K<=256, well under a minute per table and amortized over 97 tables.
RISKS: tau too small -> saturates to single-anchor; tau too large -> uniform, lift~0; length-1 histories skipped; Karcher instability near boundary (step cap 0.5, project); small Jensen bias for random tables; training/validation distribution shift; reads only level 1.
FAILURE MODE: worst on a random-hash or source-side-clustered level-1 table (lift~0 or negative), and on a collapsed one-cell table (lift=0), and on a table whose recall comes only from level-2+ codes while level 1 is meaningless.
END METRIC
